title: AUREN Global Laws, Regulations and Procedures Catalog
purpose: Country-aware discovery of official laws, regulations, regulator guidance and procedural checklists for business formation, trade, finance and operations.
importantLimitations: This is a discovery catalog, not legal advice and not a complete collection of every law.
Do not describe a law as current unless its official source, effective date and amendment status have been checked.
Jurisdiction and activity determine obligations; federal, state/provincial, municipal and sector rules may all apply.
Procedural checklists are guidance only; confirm exact forms, fees, deadlines and eligibility with the competent authority.
Store official source URL, jurisdiction, language, publication/effective dates, lastVerifiedAt, retrieval method and content hash for every ingested document.
Never scrape or redistribute content where source terms prohibit it; link users to the official page instead.
Flag machine translations and AI summaries as non-authoritative; preserve the original legal text.

defaultScope.rule: Search all connected jurisdictions and sources by default; country and region are optional filters.

legalDomains.label: Company formation and legal entities
procedureChecklist: Choose legal form and confirm eligibility
Check and reserve business name
Prepare constitutional documents and owner/director information
Register with company registry
Obtain tax identifiers and sector licences
Set annual filing and renewal reminders

legalDomains.label: Tax registration and compliance
procedureChecklist: Identify tax residence and taxable activities
Check registration thresholds and deadlines
Register for applicable tax types
Configure compliant invoices and bookkeeping
Calendar returns, payments and record retention
Confirm exemptions and appeal routes

legalDomains.label: Import, export, customs and trade controls
procedureChecklist: Classify goods and verify HS code
Check destination/origin rules and restricted-party requirements
Confirm permits, standards and product certificates
Prepare invoice, packing list, transport document and origin evidence
File customs declaration and pay applicable duties/taxes
Retain transaction records and check post-clearance obligations

legalDomains.label: Employment and workplace compliance
procedureChecklist: Identify governing labour jurisdiction and worker status
Check contract language and mandatory clauses
Verify work authorisation where applicable
Register employer and workers with relevant agencies
Implement payroll, leave, safety and grievance processes
Check dismissal, consultation and record-retention rules

legalDomains.label: Privacy, data protection and cybersecurity
procedureChecklist: Map personal data and processing purposes
Identify applicable laws and regulator
Publish notices and manage consent/rights
Set retention, access and deletion controls
Assess international transfers and vendor contracts
Create incident response and breach-notification workflow

legalDomains.label: Banking, payments, investment and financial services

Identify competent central bank or securities regulator
Confirm licence/registration and capital requirements
Implement KYC/AML, sanctions screening and reporting as required
Check client-money, disclosure and complaint rules
Verify cross-border and foreign-exchange restrictions

legalDomains.label: Product standards, safety and certifications
procedureChecklist: Identify product category and destination-market rules
Check mandatory standards and accredited test requirements
Obtain import/product approvals before shipment
Prepare labels, safety documentation and certificates
Track batch/lot traceability and complaint handling
Document recalls and corrective actions

legalDomains.label: Intellectual property
procedureChecklist: Identify protectable assets and target countries
Search existing marks/patents where appropriate
File with the relevant national or regional office
Record ownership, assignments and licence terms
Track renewals and enforcement deadlines

legalDomains.label: Environment, land and sector-specific permits
procedureChecklist: Identify location and regulated sector
Check zoning, land rights and environmental screening
Obtain permits before construction or operation
Confirm inspections, monitoring and reporting duties
Track permit conditions, renewals and restoration obligations

legalDomains.label: Consumer protection and e-commerce
procedureChecklist: Show legal seller identity and contact details
Provide clear prices, taxes, delivery and cancellation terms
Check mandatory warranties and refund rules
Review marketing, reviews and product claims
Create complaint, dispute and recall processes

procedureChecklist: Register on the relevant official procurement portal
Check eligibility, deadlines and mandatory documents
Review bid security, tax clearance and local-content rules
Declare conflicts and ownership as required

Track clarifications, award notices and appeal windows
